messages:
maria_partnerships: Heads-up: partner ops flagged a weird case where a hardware partner's marketplace feed sent cumulative counters (monotonic) but labelled them as interval deltas. Causing our ingest to sum instead of replace.

oliver_pm: Oof. Which partner and what timeframe? Can you share a sample?

maria_partnerships: Partner: acme-infra via CloudMarket. Sample snippet (sanitized):

```json
{ "acct": "acct_999", "units": 12000, "window_start": "2026-03-01T00:00:00Z", "window_end": "2026-03-01T01:00:00Z", "type": "delta" }
```

They later sent same window with units: 24000. Clearly cumulative.

jlee: We need two changes: (1) provider metadata to declare counter_type: {"cumulative","delta","total"}, and (2) ingestion logic that handles cumulative -> delta conversion by diffs based on last-seen per (customer, series_id).

devon_finance: From billing POV this can cause big overages. Do we have customers impacted? We should identify customers with month delta > 0.5% and quarantine invoices until reconciled.

sasha_support: I've already got two tickets referenced to acct_999 and acct_777. Customers noticed spikes on 2026-03-01. They expect a follow-up explanation.

eng-billing-bot: Alert: marketplace-ingest:unexpected_counter_format increased by 120% over baseline at 2026-03-03T15:22:00Z.

jlee: Quick mitigation: add a per-provider toggle to treat unknown "type" values as cumulative if values are non-decreasing and large jumps occur. Also store raw payloads and converted deltas for audit. ETA 4h.

oliver_pm: Longer term ask to partners: include series_id and counter_type in payload, and a boolean "finalized" for month-end corrections. I'll draft the partner request email and share in this thread.

devon_finance: Actionable items:
- jlee: implement cumulative->delta conversion + toggle (ETA 4h)
- jlee + eng-billing-bot: add metric for how many conversions applied and affected accounts (ETA 8h)
- maria_partnerships: send partner request for series_id/counter_type/finalized (ETA tomorrow)
- devon_finance + sasha_support: prepare customer comms template and hold credits policy for confirmed overbills (ETA EOD)

maria_partnerships: Thanks. I'll also request sample historical feeds so we can backfill corrected deltas and run a reconciliation. Please post the GH issue link when created. :thumbsup:
